title: Oh The Deacon Went Down
transcription:
Oh, The Deacon Went
Down

Oh the Deacon went down in his cellar
to pray,
He done got drunk and he stayed all
day,
Oh the Deacon went down in his cellar
to pray,
He done got drunk and he stayed all
day.

Possible verses:
Oh ya can't get to heaven
on roller skates,
You'll roll right past them pearly gates.

Oh ya can't get to heaven
on a telephone pole,
Cause the telephone pole
is stuck in a hole.

Oh ya can't get to heaven
on a rockin' chair,
You'll rock and rock and never get there.

Oh ya can't get to heaven
in my old car,
Cause my old car won't go that far.

Final Chorus:
I ain't a-gonna grieve my Lord no more
I ain't a-gonna grieve my Lord no more
I ain't a-gonna grieve my Lord no more
My Lord no more...my Lord no more
